title: Set 95

sentences.ko: 방금 음식이 왔는데 다른 건 다 맞고 매운 메뉴만 잘못 왔어요. 그걸 먹을 사람이 딸 하나인데 딸이 매운 걸 못 먹거든요. 공짜로 뭘 받으려는 건 아니고요, 그냥 아무 말 안 하고 있다가 사흘 뒤에 나쁜 후기를 남기기는 싫어서요. 지금 받은 매운 건 어떻게 할까요?
sentences.text: Hey, so the food just got here and everything's right except they sent the spicy one, and my daughter's the only one who was going to eat it and she can't do spicy. I'm not trying to get anything free, I just didn't want to stay quiet about it and then leave you a bad review three days later. What do you want me to do with the one I've got?

alts.text: Our food just showed up and everything's right except the spicy one they sent, and my daughter's the only one who was gonna eat it and she can't handle spicy. I'm not fishing for a freebie, I just didn't want to keep quiet and then hit you with a bad review in three days. So what do you want me to do with the one I've got?

Hello, the order has just arrived and everything is correct apart from the spicy dish, which my daughter was the only one planning to eat, and she cannot tolerate spice. I am not attempting to obtain anything free of charge. I simply did not want to stay silent about it and then leave you a poor review three days later. How would you like me to handle the one I have?

sentences.note: **I'm not trying to get anything free** 는 보상을 노리고 하는 말이 아니라고 미리 못 박는 표현입니다. 같은 뜻을 편하게 말하면 **fishing for a freebie** 로, 공짜를 낚으려 한다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 배달 시켰는데 엉뚱한 게 와서 얘기하기

sentences.ko: 계속 마음이 왔다 갔다 해요. 돈은 더 주고 집에서 십 분 거리인데, 거기서 그 일을 해 본 사람이 저 하나라 잘못되면 다 제 책임이거든요. 그러다가 애 낳기 전부터 지루하다고 투덜대 온 게 생각나요. 모르겠어요. 어떻게 할 건지 말해 줘요. 아마 안 듣겠지만 그래도 말해 줘요.
sentences.text: I keep going back and forth on it, because the money's better and it's ten minutes from the house, but I'd be the only person there who's done the job before, so if it falls apart it's on me. And then I remember I've been complaining about being bored since before the baby. I don't know. Tell me what you'd do and I'll probably ignore you, but say it anyway.

alts.text: I can't make up my mind on it, cause the pay's better and it's ten minutes from the house, but I'd be the only one there who's done the job before, so if it all goes sideways that's on me. And then I remember I've been whining about being bored since before the baby. I dunno. Tell me what you'd do and I'll probably ignore you, but say it anyway.

I continue to go back and forth on it, because the pay is better and it is ten minutes from the house, but I would be the only person there who has done the job before, so if it falls apart the responsibility is mine. And then I remember that I have been complaining about being bored since before the baby. I am genuinely unsure. Tell me what you would do and I will most likely ignore you, but say it regardless.

sentences.note: **go back and forth** 는 결정을 못 하고 마음이 이쪽저쪽 오가는 상태입니다. **it's on me** 는 그 책임이 나한테 있다는 말이고, **goes sideways** 는 일이 틀어진다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 친구한테 고민 상담하면서 결론은 못 내리기

sentences.ko: 솔직하게 말씀드릴게요. 아직 안 팔린 이유는 처음 보러 온 두 분이 뒤쪽을 보고 그냥 가셨기 때문이에요. 창가에 놔뒀던 자리라 아래쪽 모서리에 물에 상한 데가 있어요. 쿠션이 가려서 사진으로는 안 보이고요. 그것 말고는 멀쩡해요. 아내가 일요일까지는 치우자고 해서요, 값을 불러 주시면 아마 그대로 할게요.
sentences.text: I'll be straight with you, the reason it's still up is that the first two people who came out looked at the back of it and left. There's water damage in the bottom corner from where it sat by a window, and you can't see it in the pictures because the cushions cover it. It's solid otherwise, and my wife wants it gone by Sunday, so make me an offer and I'll probably say yes.

alts.text: Not gonna lie, it's still up because the first two people who came out took one look at the back of it and walked. There's water damage down in the bottom corner from where it sat by a window, and you can't spot it in the photos cause the cushions are covering it. It's solid other than that, and my wife wants it gone by Sunday, so throw me an offer and I'll probably take it.

I will be honest with you. The reason it is still listed is that the first two people who came to see it looked at the back of it and left. There is water damage in the bottom corner, from where it sat beside a window, and it is not visible in the photographs because the cushions cover it. It is otherwise solid, and my wife would like it gone by Sunday, so please make me an offer and I will most likely accept.

sentences.note: **I'll be straight with you** 는 숨기지 않고 솔직하게 말하겠다는 뜻입니다. **make me an offer** 는 얼마에 사겠다고 값을 불러 달라는, 중고 거래에서 자주 쓰는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 중고로 물건 팔면서 상태 솔직히 말하기

sentences.ko: 윗집이 칠월에 개를 들였는데 하루 종일 개만 혼자 있어요. 그러니까 계속 뛰어요. 우리 침실 바로 위를 아침 아홉 시쯤부터 윗집 사람이 들어올 때까지 왔다 갔다 하면서요. 그렇다고 윗집한테 화를 낼 수도 없어요. 회사에 가 있으니 알 리가 없잖아요. 그런데 저는 이제 매일 집에 있어서, 지난주에는 차에 앉아서 전화를 두 통 받았어요.
sentences.text: The people above us got a dog in July and he's alone all day, so he just runs. Back and forth, right over our bedroom, from about nine in the morning until one of them gets home. And I can't even be mad at them, because they're at work, they have no idea. But I'm home every day now, so last week I took two calls sitting in my car.

alts.text: Our upstairs neighbors got a dog back in July and he's on his own all day, so he just runs. Back and forth, right over the bedroom, from like nine in the morning till one of them gets home. And I can't even be mad at them, they're at work, they've got no clue. But I'm home every day now, so last week I took two calls from my car.

The residents above us acquired a dog in July, and he is alone all day, so he simply runs. Back and forth, directly over our bedroom, from approximately nine in the morning until one of them returns home. And I cannot even be angry with them, because they are at work and have no idea. But I am home every day now, so last week I took two calls sitting in my car.

sentences.note: **back and forth** 는 한쪽 끝에서 다른 쪽 끝으로 왔다 갔다 하는 움직임입니다. **they have no idea** 는 전혀 모르고 있다는 뜻이고, **took two calls** 는 전화를 받아 두 번 통화했다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 팀에 자기한테 묻지도 않은 질문까지 다 대답하는 사람이 있어요. 그 사람 때문에 회의마다 이십 분씩 길어져요. 그런데 그 사람 말이 틀린 게 아니라는 게 제일 답답해요. 진짜로 답을 알거든요. 그러니까 제가 한마디 하면 제가 이상한 사람이 되고요. 그래서 요즘은 회의 순서를 맨 앞으로 잡아 달라고 해요. 그 사람이 시동 걸기 전에 끝내려고요.
sentences.text: There's a guy on my team who answers every question that wasn't meant for him, and it adds twenty minutes to every meeting. And he's not wrong, that's the part that gets me, he actually does know the answer. So if I say something I'm the one with the problem. I've started asking to go first on the agenda just so I'm done before he warms up.

alts.text: We've got a guy on the team who jumps in on every question that wasn't even for him, and it tacks twenty minutes onto every meeting. And he's not wrong, that's what kills me, he really does know the answer. So if I bring it up, I'm suddenly the one with the problem. I've started asking to go first on the agenda just so I'm done before he gets going.

There is a member of my team who answers every question that was not directed at him, and it adds twenty minutes to every meeting. And he is not incorrect, which is the part that troubles me, as he genuinely does know the answer. So if I say something, I am the one with the problem. I have begun asking to go first on the agenda simply so that I am finished before he warms up.

sentences.note: **that's the part that gets me** 는 바로 그 점이 제일 거슬린다는 뜻입니다. **warms up** 은 사람이 슬슬 달아올라 본격적으로 하기 시작한다는 말로, 편하게는 **gets going** 이라고 합니다.
sentences.situation: 회사 사람 때문에 짜증난 걸 친구한테 털어놓기

reviewed: 1번 casual 의 "it's all right except" 은 "다 괜찮다" 로도 읽혀서 "everything's right except the spicy one they sent" 으로 고쳤습니다.
1번 casual 의 "and that's the problem because" 는 할 말이 끝난 뒤 붙인 군더더기라 잘라 냈습니다.
1번 formal 의 "the only one intending to eat" 이 말로는 어색해서 "the only one planning to eat" 으로 고쳤습니다.
3번 casual 의 "Full honesty," 는 원어민이 문장 첫머리에 잘 쓰지 않는 말이라 "Not gonna lie," 로 바꿨습니다.
3번 한국어에 영어의 "the first two people" 의 "처음" 이 빠져 있어 "처음 보러 온 두 분" 으로 맞췄습니다.
4번 한국어의 "전화 회의" 는 영어에 없는 말입니다. "took two calls" 는 전화 두 통을 받았다는 뜻이라 "전화를 두 통 받았어요" 로 고쳤습니다.
5번 casual 의 "jumps on every question" 은 질문에 달려들어 물고 늘어진다는 뜻으로도 읽혀서, 끼어든다는 뜻이 분명한 "jumps in on" 으로 고쳤습니다.
